description: Defines a SwiftUI view named ChatSheet which manages a chat interface, integrating external chat UI components, a view model, and transport setup for a chat session.

classes.name: ChatSheet
classes.description: A SwiftUI View representing a chat interface with dismiss capability and session handling.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Custom initializer that sets up the chat session transport, view model, and optional parameters for user accent and agent name.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Builds and returns the SwiftUI view hierarchy for the chat sheet.

methods.name: chatTitle
methods.description: Computes the chat title string based on the agent name, trimming whitespace and defaulting to 'Chat' if necessary.
